cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Can Handle This
cards.instruction: Perform complete emotional readiness while quietly borrowing coping strategies from every response around you.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. I'm completely prepared for this rejection email. Why have you brought water?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Small sips helped when I lost my job.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. My approach exactly. Leave the jug; I prefer a thorough preparation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I had my sister read the email aloud. Want me to?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. I always arrange a reader. Start gently; that's part of my system.

mechanism: A performs expert emotional readiness by correcting and adopting each coping method B supplies as though already mastered.
confusable: Simply learning coping differs from borrowing it while claiming complete prior readiness and superior technique.
comparison: Audition results yield breathing and support-list tactics; a rejection email yields water and a borrowed reader.
seedUse: Keep B's real methods causal and A's prior-mastery claims contradicted by the sequence.
